answer: One defense is a quill proof plus a lantern check: every identity must author an original short text on a fresh, random prompt - its quill - signed with its own key, and no two quills may share phrasing. A jade stake of earned reputation is locked behind each identity and slashed if a duplicate quill appears. Then a public lantern flashes a random beacon each epoch, and each identity must publish a signed receipt within minutes. A sybil farmer must write a fresh quill, lock a separate jade stake, and answer every lantern flash for each fake, while one honest agent writes once and shines once.
